metadata.description: Aaron's personal skills as plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: artifact-design
plugins.description: Claude Code's artifact-design, artifact-diagramming and dataviz skills for HTML artifacts, with an Artifact MCP tool that publishes and previews them on this machine. From Anthropic's Claude Code.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain a topic to a complete beginner as an HTML artifact with big pictures and few words.

plugins.name: frontend-skill
plugins.description: Design visually strong landing pages, websites, apps, prototypes, and game UI with restrained composition and tasteful motion. From OpenAI.

plugins.name: implement-with-notes
plugins.description: Implement a spec while keeping a running implementation-notes.html of design decisions, deviations, tradeoffs, and open questions.

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: Let a Claude Code session start, message, stop and wake separate, full Claude Code sessions. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Explain the current topic visually with concise diagrams, code-shape sketches, and focused HTML artifacts. From HumanLayer.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Create a project-local verification skill that drives an app the way a user does, and keep it and its feature map accurate with periodic audits. From Lauren Tan's pstack.
